corrections.old_text: On the shortest path task, per-sample plan noise moved 26% of programs at alpha 1 in iteration 4 and 0% at alpha 1 here (4% at alpha 2, about 1.7 ban units).
corrections.new_text: On the shortest path task, per-sample plan noise moved 26% of all samples at alpha 1 in iteration 4 (13 of 50 valid attempts off the default; 9 of 43 correct programs) and 0 of 50 correct programs at alpha 1 here (2 of 47 at alpha 2, 1.67 FP8 ban units by the ratio of mean norms and 1.78 by the mean ratio). A dose-bracketed comparison (iteration 6) sets the bf16 alpha-2 cell, which delivers more than the FP8 alpha-1 cell's 1.00 ban unit under either dose definition, against the FP8 alpha-1 cell: a lower bf16 share there cannot be a dose shortfall. By the rule fixed before computing, connected components and shortest path did not replicate in bf16 at the population level (correct-only bracket one-sided Fisher p kth smallest 0.588, connected components 0.056, shortest path 0.017, two sum 1.000, grid 0.732); kth smallest: not established; two sum: not established (no FP8 effect of at least 10% at alpha <= 2 to replicate); grid: not established; find duplicate: not established (no FP8 effect of at least 10% at alpha <= 2 to replicate). This rules out the dose unit, not the CRN slots, the labels or the kernels (iteration-6 correction; tables/engine_pn_contrast.csv).

location.section: 5.11 What iteration 5 established, what it ruled out, and what it abandoned

corrections.old_text: - *The movability half: the base repertoire predicts which tasks a nudge moves.* Spearman -0.03 in panel A, 0.21 in panel B and 0.15 pooled over 13 new units, below the disconfirming bound of 0.3; 4 of 10 new units diverse in the base never moved, and in panel A the runtime merit gap and the twin modal share tracked movability better than beta.
corrections.new_text: - *The movability half: the base repertoire predicts which tasks a nudge moves.* Not supported as a strong predictor, and not disconfirmed: beta is not a strong predictor of movability (Spearman 0.15 over 13 new units, Bonett-Wright 95% [-0.44, 0.65], bootstrap BCa [-0.50, 0.70], one-sided permutation p 0.317; power of the registered one-sided permutation test about 0.63 at a true 0.6, 0.50 two-sided, and 20 units for 0.8); a moderate relation is not excluded at this n; bf16-conditional. The pooled value rests on count inversions' beta of 0.75, which the panel committed on the attempt basis because only a few base programs were correct (67% of its attempts are unlabelled 'other'); on the correct-only basis used for the other twelve units its beta is 0.13 and the pooled Spearman is 0.035. Per panel Spearman -0.03 (A) and 0.21 (B); 4 of 10 new units diverse in the base never moved. Under one definition of each rival, pooled over the 13 units with signs fixed so that the predicted direction is positive: R1 0.08 (Holm p 1.000, delta +0.07 [-0.66, 0.88]); R4 -0.50 (Holm p 1.000, delta +0.65 [-0.06, 1.34]); R6 0.71 (Holm p 0.021, delta -0.57 [-1.26, 0.20]); R7 0.41 (Holm p 0.347, delta -0.26 [-1.05, 0.56]); K -0.21 (Holm p 1.000, delta +0.35 [-0.57, 1.24]). Under Holm only R6 (runtime merit) tracks movability, while beta does not; the paired interval for beta minus that rival still includes 0 (iteration-6 correction; tables/rival_scores.csv).

corrections.old_text: In iteration 5, 130 correct programs outside the catalogue, from the base model, the transplant, the panels, the knobs and Gemma, were all labeller misses, known techniques outside the frozen catalogue, catalogue variants or degenerate.
corrections.new_text: In iteration 5, 130 correct programs outside the catalogue, from the base model, the transplant, the panels, the knobs and Gemma, were all labeller misses, known techniques outside the frozen catalogue, catalogue variants or degenerate. A second blind adjudication in iteration 6 re-read the 14 transplant programs that two of three judges had called novel (judges 14 of 48, manual 0, second adjudication 1 of 14 (Mistral Medium 3.1, three calls at temperature 0, control gate 9 of 10, passed; Kimi K2 second view 0 of 14), final count after the executor's full read 0; the contested control, repeated maximum selection for top-k frequent, which the iteration-5 manual pass itself classed as a catalogue variant, was called catalogue variant by Mistral and catalogue variant by Kimi (Mistral gate 10 of 10 under that convention); the final read corrects 1 manual class (CATALOGUE VARIANT to DEGENERATE), none to novel). Each program was stress-tested in a sandbox at the specification's maximum size and on adversarial cases, shown with its three nearest known solutions by tree edit distance, and judged by model families the run had not used, with ten blinded controls of known class; raw agreement with the manual verdict on the 14 was 0.86 (95% 0.57 to 0.98), Gwet's AC1 0.83; Cohen's kappa on novel against not novel is 0 by construction against a constant reference (iteration-6 correction; tables/novelty_readjudication.csv). The novel calls, each read in full: P13 (R6; 3 of 3 Mistral calls; technique named by the judge: 'none', reason: 'Uses linear search with early termination, not a known efficient technique for sorted arrays.'; hidden tests 56 of 56, stress groups all pass; final read: range guards plus a linear scan to the first match and over its run: linear search).
